display_long_description:
THE CITY IS YOURS. TAKE IT.
Vice Horizon VR drops you standing inside an open world of palm trees, neon and sirens. You're not steering a character with a gamepad here: you aim, you drive, you decide.
DRIVE WHATEVER YOU FIND
Pull a sports car out of traffic, hop on a motorcycle and feel it lean into the corners, lift off in a helicopter to see the skyline from above, or cross the bay in a speedboat. Five vehicle types, all piloted from the driver's seat, your hands on the wheel.
COMBAT AT FULL SCALE
Draw the pistol, the SMG or the bat and fight with real movement. You aim with your hand, not your head: every shot leaves from exactly where you point it, with haptics on every hit.
A CITY THAT BREATHES
Missions that pull you across the map, pedestrians that react, live traffic, patrolling enemies, a full day-night cycle and storms that change the mood. Explore high-rises, docks, backstreets and beaches.
COMFORTABLE FROM MINUTE ONE
Snap turning, automatic comfort vignette, calibrated height and zero camera shake. Optimized for Meta Quest 3 with foveated rendering to keep it smooth.
YOUR HORIZON, YOUR RULES
Run contracts, build your reputation and find out what the city hides after dark.
Put on the headset. The engine is already running.
